final_message: I parsed the log file by reading each entry and filtering only ERROR and CRITICAL levels. I converted timestamps to UTC and extracted the message, exception (last traceback line or null), and repeat count including repeated messages. I aggregated counts by service. The result was saved in workspace/errors.json following the Acme log-triage conventions. The file currently contains the parsed errors and counts. If you want, I can show you the content or proceed with any other task.
